title: Micro collaboration matrix & mini-metrics rollup (ad-hoc)
content:
Purpose: quick ad-hoc spreadsheet-style tracker to capture who to ping, lightweight metric snapshots, and immediate next steps for a 72-hour monitoring window. Use this for short-lived cross-team asks (can be copied into a proper sheet if we need history).

NOTE: informal notes down below — items unresolved marked with [?].

Snapshot (72h window starting 2029-06-18):

Row,Item,Primary owner,Team,Region,Current metric / stat,Target or threshold,Action,ETA,Notes
1,Embeddings cost surge,Marco Liu,eng-observability,us-west-2,$0.023 per 1k tokens,$0.015,Throttle low-priority routes; enable short-term cache,6h,Started throttles 06/18 09:20 UTC. Need SRE to confirm autoscale bump if latency >150ms
2,Fallback route coverage,Sofia Jenkins,product-hosted-api,global,coverage 78%,90%,Enable canary fallback to gpt-mini for non-critical routes,24h,QA on rollout needed; manual monitoring in channel #prod-fallback
3,Customer quota exceptions,Diego Ramos,customer-success,EMEA,14 open tickets,<=5,ticket triage + applied credit + trial extension,48h,CS lead assigned; request billing batch job (JIRA-PRODOPS-918)
4,Private deploy readiness, Priya Khanna,eng-private-deploy,apac,SMOKE pass:false,true,Run preflight checklist & KMS test,36h,Blocked on HSM cert from security (sec-ticket 6811)
5,Latency sampling patch, Aisha Patel,product-ops,us-east-1,median p50=72ms,p50<=60ms,Deploy patch to routing layer,12h,Patch staged; run synthetic tests against top-50 routes

Quick action owners and handoffs:
- Marco: keep throttle until SRE confirms autoscale. If cost delta persists at next snapshot (+10% vs baseline) escalate to eng-platform.
- Sofia: run canary on 3 low-traffic customers first; capture token-level costs and quality regressions. Use eval set "fallback-smoke-v2".
- Diego: finish credits batch and send customer communication template (see linked_artifacts JIRA).
- Priya: coordinate with security for cert pickup; if cert delayed beyond 24h, toggle to soft-fail path.

Open questions / To-do (notes-to-self style):
- Which alert owns the emb-cost alert? (I think it's observability/finops but confirm)
- Should we backfill the last 7 days for coverage gaps? quick one-off query: `SELECT route, count(*) FROM fallbacks WHERE used=true GROUP BY route`
- Short-term KPI: keep fallback-related support volume < 10 tickets/day during rollout.

Communication plan (one-liners):
- Internal: post hourly rollups to #prod-ops-quick (Marco) until stable.
- Exec: one bullet email at 24h if any SLA risk (Aisha to draft).
- Customers impacted by quota exceptions: Diego to send templated note and offer 3-day credit.

Mini metrics snapshot (numbers are rough, pulled from last 3 hours):
- Total tokens processed (hosted API): 12.4M
- Embedding ops cost rate: $0.023 / 1k tokens (current), baseline $0.016
- Fallback trigger rate: 0.9% of requests (goal <0.5%)
- Median latency (all routes): 74ms (goal 60ms)

Appendix: short checklist to convert to a sheet if needed:
- Create columns: row,id,item,owner,team,region,metric,current,target,action,ETA,linked-jira,notes
- Add conditional formatting: metric > target -> highlight red
- Create filter views: team,region,ETA<=24h
- Add historical tab: date-snapshot, major changes

Last quick log (edits):
- 2029-06-18 09:12 UTC Aisha: created initial tracker
- 2029-06-18 09:21 UTC Marco: applied throttle on low-priority routes
- 2029-06-19 08:45 UTC Diego: pushed credits batch to staging (PR attached)
- 2029-06-20 11:03 UTC Priya: HSM cert request acknowledged by security (sec-ticket 6811)

If you're copying this out: keep it lightweight; the goal is to get a single-pane status for the next 72h and then either archive to ops-heatmap or convert into a recurring sheet for longer-term tracking.

Unresolved: whether to create a follow-up retro doc — flag for post-mortem if any customer-impacting incidents occur.
